label: prf:alpha-em-shift-multiplicative-chain
title: Proof of alpha em shift multiplicative chain
html:
The identity composes two named identities:

  1. Electromagnetic coupling from the antisymmetric braiding and force-carrier crossings establishes the bare combinatorial form:

      \alpha_{EM}^{-1} \;=\; q \cdot [9]_q \cdot [10]_q.

    This is derived from the antisymmetric eigenvalue -q^{-1} of the R-matrix and the q-deformed crossing numbers of the force-carrier generators T_{2,9} and T_{3,5}. By (T_{2,9}, T_{3,5}) is the unique pair of genus-4 torus knots, this basis consists exactly of the genus-4 saturating torus-knot set on \Sigma_4.

  2. Pole order at q=0 of the torus-knot character: \alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{p,k}) = k(p-1) on V_{(1^p)} establishes the closed-form identity:

      \alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{p,k}) \;=\; k(p-1)
  \qquad (\gcd(p, k) = 1)

    on the all-anti-symmetric channel V_{(1^p)}. Specialise at (p, k) \in \{(2, 9), (3, 5)\}:

      \alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{2,9}) \;=\; 9 \cdot 1 \;=\; 9,
  \qquad
  \alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{3,5}) \;=\; 5 \cdot 2 \;=\; 10.

Substituting these values into the bare formula yields the stated identity exactly:

  \alpha_{EM}^{-1}
  \;=\; q \cdot [9]_q \cdot [10]_q
  \;=\; q \cdot \bigl[\alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{2,9})\bigr]_q
              \cdot \bigl[\alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{3,5})\bigr]_q.
  \qquad \square

Numerical verification

The composition holds exactly at the symbolic level. Numerical re-evaluation at q_0 (50-digit arithmetic) takes the upstream values \alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{2,9}) and \alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{3,5}). It compares the chain expression to the bare expression:

  |\,\text{chain} - \text{bare}\,| \;=\; 0

identically to mpmath precision, with both equalling \alpha_{EM}^{-1}(q_0) \approx 136.823. The gap |\,\text{chain} - \text{CODATA}\,| \approx 0.213 is the \mathcal{O}(10^{-3}) precision gap inherited from Electromagnetic coupling from the antisymmetric braiding and force-carrier crossings. This refactoring leaves it unchanged. Closing this gap requires Conjectured categorical derivation of E_h = m_e c_q^2 \alpha_{EM}^2 and higher-order C_5-invariant corrections.

All 3 assertions in the witness pass.
